verdict.line: You lose lane if you auto-attack into his Counter Strike (Q) or get caught overextended right as he hits 6; you win every extended trade and side-lane split once you have two items.

brief.thesis: Fiora's W (Riposte) directly answers the two tools Jax uses to force trades — the Empowered Strike (E) auto and the Leap Strike (Q) gap-close — while his Counter Strike (Q) only punishes basic attacks, not her dash-based poke. Because of that asymmetry, this lane is decided by who initiates the exchange, not by stats: if you lead with Q (Lunge) or bait his dodge window instead of auto-attacking blind, you take almost no free damage from him.

theirWindow.what: Grandmaster's Might (R) gives him burst armor/MR plus an AoE stun on activation, and paired with a Leap Strike (Q) into Empowered Strike (E) he can chain a stun into a kill. Don't stand in melee range with your Flash down at this window.

yourWindow.when: right after his Counter Strike (Q) whiffs or ends
yourWindow.what: Counter Strike has a real cooldown (roughly 14s at rank 1, shorter at rank 5), so once it's down he has no stun and no dodge. All-in immediately with Q (Lunge) into E (Bladework) for the double empowered autos onto his revealed vital.

start.why: You want to win short trades and sustain through his poke; the extra HP and lifesteal from Doran's Blade matter more here than early armor since Jax has no ranged poke pre-6.

boots.why: Jax's damage is heavily auto-attack based (passive stacks, Empowered Strike autos), so the flat auto-attack damage reduction directly cuts his all-in and his late-game on-hit scaling.

core.why: The attack speed and burst-damage proc let you cash in vitals faster and win the trades you initiate with Q (Lunge).
Lifesteal swings extended duels in your favor and the shield covers his level-6 stun combo.

runes.keystoneWhy: This is a sustained-trade duelist matchup, and Conqueror's healing directly counters Jax's own sustain and his all-in burst once fully stacked.

summoners.why: Flash covers his level-6 all-in and Counter Strike stun windows, and Teleport lets you commit to the lane knowing you can still answer sidewaves once you're ahead.

playing.title: Never auto into Counter Strike
playing.detail: When Jax activates Q (Counter Strike) he dodges the next two seconds of basic attacks and then stuns anyone nearby. Stop auto-attacking the instant you see it trigger and poke with Q (Lunge) instead.

playing.title: Watch his E icon for empowered autos
playing.detail: Jax's E (Empowered Strike) primes his next basic attack to deal bonus magic damage, and it stuns if that auto follows a Leap Strike (Q) engage. If his E is up and he jumps on you, riposte the incoming auto with W.

playing.title: Riposte the leap-strike follow-up
playing.detail: Time W (Riposte) for the auto that lands right after his Q (Leap Strike) engage — parrying it both denies his stun and stuns him back, flipping the trade entirely.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 all-in window
playing.detail: Grandmaster's Might gives him burst armor/MR and an AoE stun on activation. From level 6 on, don't sit in melee range below 60% HP with your Flash and W both down.

playing.title: Chain E into vital resets
playing.detail: Use E (Bladework) to guarantee two empowered autos onto his revealed vital for true damage and the attack-speed/heal proc; do this every short trade, not just all-ins.

playing.title: Punish Counter Strike cooldown
playing.detail: Once he burns Counter Strike defensively, it's down for roughly 14 seconds early and shorter at higher ranks. That's your green light to force an all-in with no stun risk from him.

playing.title: Split-push once you have two items
playing.detail: Past Trinity Force and Bloodthirster you out-duel Jax 1v1 even through his ultimate. Prioritize side-lane splits so your ultimate (Grand Challenge) rewards you with true damage in isolated fights.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names here reflect the last full patch cycle in my training data — Trinity Force, Kraken Slayer, and the Precision/Resolve rune trees have all seen numbers or component reworks before, so confirm current stats and prices in the in-client shop and rune page before locking build order.
